title: Want to code your own strategy & Indicator?
author: AcanthocephalaNo6605
selftext:
While25: A programmable trading platform that directly connects to your broker feed and routes real orders from your workspace.

It contains advanced charting, a smart order routing system, an inbuilt code editor, and an AI assistant that can work along with you. It comes with an inbuilt Python SDK to design your custom algorithm, indicator, dashboard, and even ML/DL models.

We are rolling out our initial build to users tomorrow at https://while25.com.
